skills.name: Dance of the Wind (风之舞/風の舞)
skills.description: Itsumade mauls a single target, dealing damage equal to 60% of her ATK. She inflicts 1 follow-up attack for each layer of Golden Feather on herself (does not trigger when counter-attacking). Also inflicts 1 follow-up attack for each layer of Golden Feather inflicted on the target. She can inflict up to 4 follow-up attacks in total. ;Golden Feather (黄金の羽) : :'''Debuff, Status''': When inflicted on an enemy, inflicts them with 6%/18%/36% of Heal Down and based on how many layers they have. :''(1-3 golden feathers will circle around Itsumade based on how many layers she has.)''

skills.name: Golden Feather (黄金羽毛/黄金の羽)
skills.line: Feathers aren't always soft, you know...
skills.description:
At the start of Itsumade's turn, she gains 1-3 layers of Golden Feather.
When she receives damage, she transfers 1 layer onto the damage source (up to 3 layers).
When she is KO'd, each enemy with Golden Feather takes damage equal to 40% of her ATK for each layer of Golden Feather on them, consuming all layers. ; : ;Golden Feather (黄金の羽) : :'''Debuff, Status''': When inflicted on an enemy, inflicts them with 6%/18%/36% of Heal Down and based on how many layers they have. :''(1-3 golden feathers will circle around Itsumade based on how many layers she has.)''

upgrades.text: '''Golden Feather''': Heal Down and Vulnerability increases to 7%/21%/42%.
'''Golden Feather''': Heal Down and Vulnerability increases to 8%/24%/48%.
'''Golden Feather''': Heal Down and Vulnerability increases to 9%/27%/54%.
'''Golden Feather''': Heal Down and Vulnerability increases to 10%/30%/60%.

skills.name: Feather Dance (千羽风之/千本羽)
skills.line: That's what you get for being greedy!
skills.description: Itsumade rises into the air and dives into the enemy's lineup to land an attack, dealing damage equal to 60% of her ATK to all enemies. For each layer of Golden Feather she has, she inflicts additional dealing damage equal to 36% of her ATK to all enemies. On each enemy with Golden Feather, she inflicts additional dealing damage equal to 40% of her ATK for each layer of Golden Feather they have, consuming all layers. ;Golden Feather (黄金の羽) : :'''Debuff, Status''': When inflicted on an enemy, inflicts them with 6%/18%/36% of Heal Down and based on how many layers they have. :''(1-3 golden feathers will circle around Itsumade based on how many layers she has.)''

upgrades.text: Damage for the first attack increases to 63%.
